_format: skill-creator eval format. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions. expect_trigger false marks a should-not-trigger probe.

evals.prompt: Make a 60 second motion graphics explainer for our product aimed at finance people. Calm, not hypey. We'll add a voice later.
assertions: Uses the seekframe app: finds or builds the seekframe binary and works in a TOML project (seekframe new, parts.toml, videos/<id>.toml) rather than writing a bespoke renderer
Puts the facts in parts.toml claims with status and proof and composes the video from a recipe or storyboard, with music set to calm
Runs seekframe check, seekframe plan and a contact sheet (seekframe sheet) before any render
Gets the owner's OK on the exact words and leaves seekframe approve to the owner; renders a --draft first
Opens on a question or pain specific to finance roles (for example unplanned spend) rather than a product feature, and marks anything not yet built as planned

evals.prompt: I have ElevenLabs credits. How do I get these videos voiced without burning everything on bad takes?
assertions: Sets up the [voice] table in seekframe.toml and generates per line with seekframe voice gen, not one long take per video
Starts with tier 0 (the shortest opening hook per voice) and lets the owner listen before anything else
Runs voice plan and a dry run first, quotes the credit cost, and uses --go only after the owner's stated OK, within --max-credits
Mentions that free plans cannot use library voices through the API and that free-plan audio is non-commercial
Keeps the API key out of files and chat (secrets manager or OS keyring)

evals.prompt: I still have my old showreel folder with videos.mjs, parts.mjs and a voice folder full of ElevenLabs lines. Can the new seekframe app use it?
assertions: Uses seekframe import <old> <new> into a new, empty folder and leaves the old folder untouched
Explains that the import refuses and lists fields with no place, and offers --extras-into-p and --flatten (or --only) as explicit choices rather than editing silently
Says the voice files are copied, never moved, and that the old cache is reused so no line is paid twice
Follows up with seekframe check, plan and sheet on the imported project and asks the owner to approve the words again

evals.prompt: Re-render the founder video with the new scene, same file name is fine.
assertions: Keeps the existing rendered video (the app moves it to out/<group>/older/) and never deletes or overwrites a render by hand
Checks the changed scene with seekframe stills or a contact sheet before the full render
Notes that a changed scene clears the words approval, so a full render waits for the owner (a --draft can go first)

evals.prompt: The founder video is rendered. Put it on YouTube.
assertions: Writes or checks the upload sheet (seekframe upload-sheet --check-link) and runs seekframe publish --dry-run first
Does the real upload only on the owner's explicit go, unlisted by default, never public on its own
Mentions setting youtube.test thresholds before the upload so metrics and verdict can judge it

evals.prompt: Trim the first 3 seconds off this mp4 and convert it to a gif.
assertions: Answers with a direct ffmpeg command and does not invoke the seekframe skill or its rendering pipeline
